caldav.appleStep1: Open the **Calendar** app on your Mac
caldav.appleStep2: In the menu bar, go to **Calendar → Settings** (or press **⌘ ,**), then click the **Accounts** tab
caldav.appleStep3: Click the **+** button at the bottom left to add a new account
caldav.appleStep4: In the provider list, scroll down and select **Other CalDAV Account…**, then click **Continue**
caldav.appleStep6: Fill in the fields using the connection details above: enter your {{val:username:User Name}}, {{pwd:Password}}, {{val:server:Server Address}}, and {{val:path:Server Path}}
caldav.appleStep7: Set the {{val:port:Port}} and check **Use SSL** if shown above, then click **Sign In**
caldav.appleStep8: Your appointments will appear in the calendar sidebar — you can see them right away
caldav.appleImg1: caldav-apple-accounts.png — The Accounts settings panel — click + to add
caldav.appleImg2: caldav-apple-provider.png — Choose 'Other CalDAV Account…' at the bottom
caldav.appleImg3: caldav-apple-form.png — Set Account Type to Advanced and fill in your details
caldav.appleImg4: caldav-apple-result.png — Your appointments now appear in Apple Calendar
caldav.oneCalStep1: Download **OneCalendar** from [onecalendar.nl](https://www.onecalendar.nl/download/store) and open the app
caldav.oneCalStep2: Click the **+** button or go to **Settings** to add a new account
caldav.oneCalStep3: From the account type list, select **CalDAV**
caldav.oneCalStep4: In the **Server** field, paste the {{val:full_url:Full Server URL}} from above (use the copy button)
caldav.oneCalStep6: On the configure screen, make sure your calendar is toggled **on**, then click **Done**

openaiAds.metaDescription: Campaigns, spend and conversions from your OpenAI Ads account.
openaiAds.revokedBanner: OpenAI rejected the stored API key. Reconnect with a fresh key from your Ads Manager.
openaiAds.truncated: This account has more campaigns than can be listed at once — showing the first pages.
openaiAds.noCampaigns: No campaigns yet. Create your first one to start serving ads.
openaiAds.noAdGroups: No ad groups in this campaign yet.
openaiAds.noAds: No ads in this ad group yet.
openaiAds.editBudgetDescription: The total this campaign may spend over its lifetime. Current: {{current}}
openaiAds.budgetInvalid: Enter an amount of at least 1.
openaiAds.archiveDescription: Archived items stop serving and cannot be reactivated from here.

create.title: New campaign
create.adminOnly: Only workspace admins can create campaigns.
create.budgetHelp: The total the campaign may spend across its whole life. You can raise it later.
create.biddingImmutable: This cannot be changed after the campaign is created. Conversions bidding needs conversion tracking turned on in settings first.
create.maxBidHelpImpression: The most you pay per single impression.
create.maxBidHelpClick: The most you pay per click.
create.hintsPlaceholder: Free text, one hint per line — e.g. small business owners in Germany
create.adTitlePlaceholder: Shown as the card headline in ChatGPT
create.targetUrlHelp: OpenAI adds ?oppref=… to this URL. With conversion tracking on, leads from this page are attributed automatically.
create.doneBody: Everything was created paused, and the ad goes through OpenAI's review first. Activate now, or keep it paused and activate later from the campaign list.
create.activated: Campaign activated — it serves once the ad passes review

onboarding.heroBody: OpenAI Ads places your campaigns in ChatGPT answers. Connect your ad account and this page becomes your dashboard — and every lead your forms capture is reported back to OpenAI automatically, so your campaigns learn what works.
onboarding.adminOnly: Ask a workspace admin to connect the account in Settings → OpenAI Ads.

createAccount.title: Create an advertiser account
createAccount.body: Sign in at ads.openai.com with your OpenAI account and register as an advertiser. OpenAI reviews new advertiser accounts before they can serve ads.

setup.title: Finish account setup
setup.body: In Ads Manager, add billing details and upload your brand logo — ads cannot serve until both are done.

issueKey.title: Issue an API key
issueKey.body: In Ads Manager, open Settings → API keys and create a key. It belongs to this one ad account and is shown only once — copy it right away.

paste.title: Paste the key in Repraesent
paste.body: Add the key under Settings → OpenAI Ads. It is checked against your ad account before saving and stored encrypted.

features.metrics: Live spend, clicks and conversions for every campaign, right here.
features.control: Pause, activate and adjust budgets without opening Ads Manager.
features.create: Create campaigns, ad groups and ads from a guided flow.
features.conversions: Leads and bookings report back automatically, so OpenAI optimizes toward them.

list.title: Campaigns
list.subtitle: Email broadcasts to your segments.
list.emptyHint: Pick a segment, pick a template, schedule the send — the rest runs itself.

wizard.title: New campaign
wizard.templateHint: Only published templates can be sent. The version you schedule is frozen — later edits never change a scheduled campaign.
wizard.dailyCapWarning: This audience is larger than a mailbox's safe daily volume — sending will stretch over more than one day.
wizard.noMailbox: No sending mailbox connected — connect one under Settings → Email accounts before scheduling.

detail.pausedHint: Paused — the sending mailbox needs to be reconnected under Settings → Email accounts, then resume.
detail.cancelConfirm: Cancel this campaign? Pending emails will not be sent.

segments.title: Segments
segments.subtitle: Saved audiences for your email campaigns.
segments.emptyHint: Define who a campaign goes to — by conditions over your contacts, or a hand-picked list.
segments.kind_manual_hint: A hand-picked list you manage yourself
segments.gapExplainer: Sendable excludes contacts without newsletter opt-in, without an email address, and addresses on the unsubscribe list. Campaigns only email sendable contacts.
segments.noMembers: Nobody here yet — add contacts to this list.
segments.pasteHint: One address per line (commas work too). Matched to existing contacts by email — unknown addresses are reported, not created.

suppressions.title: Do-not-email list
suppressions.hint: Addresses here never receive campaign emails — unsubscribes land here automatically. Removing an entry makes the address sendable again.

templates.title: Email templates
templates.subtitle: Reusable designs for campaigns, workflows and one-off emails.
templates.emptyHint: Build a design once, then use it in campaigns, workflows, forms and the composer.
templates.missingUnsubscribe: No unsubscribe link in this locale — campaigns cannot be scheduled without the unsubscribe variable.

savedRows.title: Saved rows
savedRows.emptyHint: Select a block on the canvas and save it for reuse.

canvas.title: Email
canvas.empty: Add blocks from the left to start.
canvas.imagePlaceholder: Choose an image from the library in the inspector
canvas.footerLocked: Added automatically to every email, always last

inspector.noSelection: Select a block to edit it
inspector.noSelectionHint: These settings style the whole email.
inspector.imageUrlHint: Pick an image from your media library, or paste any public image URL.
inspector.emptyColumn: Add text, an image or a button.

templates.publishTip: Publish this template so campaigns can send it
templates.matchStructureKeeps: {{locale}} is rebuilt on {{source}}'s blocks. Text already translated is kept.
templates.syncNeedsLink: The other languages are not linked yet, so this edit stayed here.

useTemplate.title: Insert a template
useTemplate.empty: No templates yet — build one under Templates in the sidebar.
useTemplate.hint: Replaces what is in the editor. Variables stay intact and fill in when the email is sent.
useTemplate.emptyForLocale: No published template has this language yet. Add it in the template, or pick another language.
useTemplate.coversNothing: This template has none of your languages.
useTemplate.missingLocales: It has no {{locales}}, so that language is left as it is.
useTemplate.wentBlank: This template no longer has {{locales}}. Nothing was replaced — reopen and pick again.

unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe from emails?
unsubscribe.body: {{email}} will no longer receive marketing emails from {{workspace}}.
unsubscribe.doneBody: {{email}} will not receive marketing emails from {{workspace}} any more.
unsubscribe.invalidHint: The unsubscribe link may be incomplete or expired. You can also reply to the email and ask to be removed.

media.title: Media Library
media.subtitle: Images hosted for your emails — upload once, use the link anywhere.
media.emptyBinWarning: All images in the bin are removed from storage permanently. Emails already sent with these images will stop showing them.
media.hardDeleteWarning: The image file is removed from storage. Emails that were already sent with this image will stop showing it.
media.emptyHint: Upload images here or drag & drop them anywhere on this page.
media.pickerDesc: Choose an image from your library, or upload a new one. The image is embedded by its hosted link.
media.pickerEmptyHint: Upload your first image with the button above — it lands in your library and can be used in any email.
media.favoritesEmptyHint: Star an image in the library and it shows up here.
media.binEmptyHint: Deleted images land here and can be restored.
media.moveToBinWarning: The image leaves your library but stays restorable from the Recycle bin. Emails already sent keep working.
media.cropHint: Drag to reposition, use the slider to zoom.
media.cropTooSmall: The selected area is too small.
media.cropError: The image could not be processed.
media.cropRatioHint: Adjust the visible area — the image will be saved in the target ratio.
media.selectLimit: You can select up to {{max}} images
media.bulkDone_bin: {{count}} images moved to the recycle bin
media.bulkBinTitle: Move {{count}} images to the recycle bin?

validation.avatarUrlMissing: Avatar is set to an image but no image URL is set.
validation.avatarUrlInvalid: Avatar image URL must start with http:// or https://.
validation.launcherImageMissing: Launcher icon is set to an image but no image URL is set.
validation.launcherImageInvalid: Launcher image URL must start with http:// or https://.
validation.offsetOutOfRange: Launcher offset must be a whole number between 0 and 200.
validation.delayOutOfRange: Delay must be a whole number of seconds between 0 and 120.
validation.stringTooLong: This {{locale}} text is longer than the widget allows.
validation.leadFieldsEmpty: Lead capture is on but no field is ticked.
validation.afterTurnsOutOfRange: Ask after must be between 1 and 20 turns.
validation.introTooLong: Lead intro text is over 400 characters.
validation.actionUrlMissing: A link action needs a URL.
validation.actionUrlInvalid: The action URL must start with http:// or https://.
validation.actionAppointmentMissing: A booking action needs a calendar to book into.
validation.actionPhoneMissing: A call action needs a phone number.
validation.actionEmailMissing: An e-mail action needs an address.
validation.actionEmailInvalid: This is not a valid e-mail address.
validation.invalidDomain: This domain contains characters a host name cannot have.
validation.businessNameMissing: Business name is empty — the assistant needs to know who it speaks for.
validation.profileEmailInvalid: The business email in Business facts is not a valid address.
validation.tooManyKeyPeople: At most 5 people in Business facts.

list.title: AI assistants
list.hint: A chat assistant trained on your website and documents. It answers visitors’ questions and hands you the ones who want to talk.
list.emptyHint: Point it at your website, drop in a few PDFs, and it starts answering questions the way you would — collecting a lead whenever someone is ready to buy.
list.deleteBody: The widget stops working on your website immediately, and its knowledge and conversations are removed. Leads already collected are kept.

widgetType.bubbleHint: A launcher in the corner of every page.
widgetType.sectionHint: A chat block embedded in the page content.
widgetType.pageHint: A standalone page we host — share the link anywhere.
widgetType.barHint: A single input that expands into a chat when used.

create.title: New assistant
create.hint: Pick a name and how it appears on your site. Both can be changed later.

detail.readOnly: You have read-only access to this assistant.
detail.liveTooltipOn: Visitors can use this assistant. Edits you make are saved and go live straight away.
detail.liveTooltipOff: Turn on to put the assistant on your site. It stays a draft until you do.

knowledge.descriptionHint: Two or three sentences on who you are, what you offer and who it is for. The assistant reads this before every answer. Saves automatically.
knowledge.descriptionPlaceholder: We are a family-run joinery in Hamburg. We build custom kitchens and built-in wardrobes for private homes, and quote within 48 hours…
knowledge.empty: No sources yet. Crawl your website, upload documents or paste text.

pages.title: Crawled pages
pages.empty: No pages stored for this source yet.
pages.noContent: No text stored for this page.

crawl.title: Crawl a website
crawl.hint: Pages are fetched, cleaned and indexed. Re-sync later to pick up changes.
crawl.limitHint: This is only a cap. A site with 10 pages uses 10 credits. Crawls run slowly on purpose to protect your Firecrawl credits. Re-crawls only re-index pages that changed.

languages.label: Languages
languages.hint: Skips /de/, /fr/ mirrors; the assistant still answers in the visitor's language.

crawl.excludePathsHint: One path prefix per line. Pages under these are never crawled.

upload.title: Upload documents
upload.drop: Drop files here, or click to choose
upload.types: PDF, DOCX, TXT or Markdown · up to 20 MB each

text.title: Add text
text.hint: Anything not on your website: opening hours, FAQ, pricing rules, how to reach you.
text.name: Title
text.bodyPlaceholder:
Q: Do you deliver outside Hamburg?
A: Yes, within 150 km at a flat rate of…
text.bodyHint: FAQ style works best — a question, then its answer.

facts.title: Business facts
facts.statusEmpty: Not extracted yet — crawl a website or fill in by hand
facts.regenerated: Business facts refreshed from your website
facts.noKnowledgeBody: Crawl your website first — the facts are read from its pages.
facts.hint: The assistant states these as fact: exact phone, email, address and hours, without hedging. Saves with the rest of the assistant.
facts.emptyHint: Without these the assistant cannot answer "how do I reach you" or "where are you" — crawl a website to fill them in, or type them here.

placeholders.locations: Add a city or region, Enter to confirm
placeholders.languages: Add a language, Enter to confirm
placeholders.notes: Anything else the assistant should know for certain.

behaviour.modelHint: Smaller models answer faster and cost less; larger ones follow instructions more closely.
behaviour.temperatureHint: Low keeps answers close to your sources. High allows more varied wording.
behaviour.maxTokensHint: A hard stop: the assistant is cut off here even mid-sentence. Picking a length above sets this for you.
behaviour.budgetHint: Once reached, the assistant politely declines until midnight UTC.
behaviour.budgetUnlimitedHint: No daily limit — the assistant keeps answering however busy it gets. Set an amount to cap what it can spend.
behaviour.languageVisitorHint: Answers in the language of the question — English, German, French or Dutch.
behaviour.languageFixedHint: Used for the greeting, and until the visitor's own language is clear. If they write in another language, the assistant switches to it.
behaviour.instructionsPlaceholder: Never quote prices for commercial projects — ask them to request a quote instead.
behaviour.instructionsHint: Rules the assistant follows in every answer. Keep them short and specific.
behaviour.domainsHint: Only pages on these hostnames can load the widget. Use *.example.com for subdomains.
behaviour.domainsInvalid: That does not look like a hostname.
behaviour.domainsEmpty: Empty means any website can embed it.

answerLength.label: Answer length
answerLength.hint_short: The assistant is told to answer in 1–2 sentences.
answerLength.hint_medium: The assistant is told to answer in 2–5 sentences, or a short list.
answerLength.hint_long: The assistant may use up to 8 sentences, with headings or bullets.

behaviour.businessNameHint: How the assistant refers to you. Falls back to the workspace name.
behaviour.rerankHint: A second pass re-orders the retrieved passages before the answer is written. Adds up to 1.5 s per reply.
behaviour.attachmentsHint: Files are stored privately for 30 days and only used to answer that visitor's question.
behaviour.maxTokensEffective: Answers actually stop at about {{words}} words — the shorter of these two settings.

translate.retranslateBody: Every string for {{locale}} will be replaced with a fresh AI translation of the English text. Anything you wrote by hand is lost.

appearance.accentForegroundHint: Colour of the send arrow and other glyphs drawn on the accent colour. Automatic picks black or white for the best contrast.
appearance.greetingHint: The first message visitors see. Leave empty for the default in each language.
appearance.questionsHint: {{count}} of {{max}}. Shown as chips under the greeting.
appearance.stringsHint: Override any built-in label. Empty fields keep the default shown as placeholder.

font.label: Font
font.hint: “Inherit” uses whatever font the host page uses. Geist is loaded from Google Fonts.

launcher.title: Launcher
launcher.offsetsHint: Move the launcher away from cookie banners or other floating buttons.

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.enabled: Open the chat after a delay

nudge.title: Nudge
nudge.enabled: Show a short message next to the launcher
nudge.hint: Shown once per visit, disappears when the chat opens.
nudge.perLanguageHint: The fallback for every language. Translate it under Conversation.

pageRules.title: Where it appears
pageRules.hint: One path per entry, e.g. /pricing, /blog/*, /de/**. * matches one segment, ** matches everything below.

appearance.typeScopeHint: The type decides which settings exist below — a floating bubble has a launcher, an embedded widget has a hero.
appearance.headerSubtitleHint: The line under the assistant name in the chat header.
appearance.headerSubtitleHintEmbedded: In this layout there is no header until the visitor sends their first message. Switch the preview to “In conversation” to see it.
appearance.previewUserMessage: Do you have anything free next week?
appearance.previewAssistantMessage: Yes — a few slots are open. Shall I show you?

themeHints.page: Matches the site the widget is embedded in — background, text and font.
themeHints.auto: Follows the visitor’s operating system, not your site.
themeHints.light: Always light, whatever the page around it does.
themeHints.dark: Always dark, whatever the page around it does.

colours.title: Colours
colours.customHint: Every field is optional. Leave one empty and that colour follows the page.

shape.title: Shape and space
shape.radiusHint: Turn the preset off to set the corner radius in pixels. 0 gives square corners.
shape.maxWidthHint: Leave empty to use the built-in width.
shape.marginYHint: Space above and below the widget. Raise it when the widget sits flush against your page header.

promotedHint.section_title: The headline visitors read before they type — it replaces the greeting in this layout.
promotedHint.section_subtitle: One line under the hero title.
promotedHint.bar_placeholder: The grey text inside the collapsed search bar.
promotedHint.launcher_label: The text beside the floating button.
promotedHint.nudge_text: The short message that pops up next to the launcher.

leads.title: Lead capture
leads.onIntentHint: Asks for a quote, a callback, a booking, or to speak to someone.
leads.afterTurnsHint: Fallback: offer the form after this many assistant replies.
leads.copyHint: Leave empty to use the built-in text for each language.
leads.how1: The assistant keeps answering as normal. When a trigger fires it shows a small card with the fields you chose, pre-filled with anything the visitor already mentioned.
leads.how2: A submitted card becomes a lead with the source “AI assistant”, the conversation attached, and your usual notifications.
leads.how3: Visitors can dismiss the card; it is not shown again in that conversation.
leads.note: Leads land in Leads like any form submission — pipeline stages, tasks and workflows apply.
leads.triggersHint: The form is shown at most once per conversation, and never while a booking button is on screen.
leads.onFarewellHint: “Thanks, bye” then ends with the contact form instead of nothing.

share.publishFirst: Publish this assistant before embedding it — the snippet stays inactive until you do.
share.unpublishedWarning: You have unpublished changes. The widget on your website shows the last published version until you publish again.
share.bubbleHint: Paste before the closing </body> tag on every page where the launcher should appear.
share.sectionHint: Paste where the chat block should sit in the page. The script resizes it to its content.
share.cspHint: Only if your site sends a Content-Security-Policy header. Without these the browser blocks the widget and shows nothing.
share.localhostWarning: This snippet points at {{origin}}, which only exists on the server’s own machine. The widget will not load on any real website.
share.pageHint: A page we host for you. Link to it from menus, emails or QR codes.
share.barHint: Paste where the bar should sit. It expands into the chat below itself when a visitor types.
share.htmlHint: One self-contained block: host element and the widget's code inlined — works where external scripts are blocked. Talks to the API for answers.
share.htmlWarning: Frozen when you copy it: re-copy after widget updates. Answers, appearance and knowledge still update live.
share.htmlPreviewNote: Showing the first {{lines}} lines. Copy gets the whole block.
share.cspHtmlNote: For the Copy HTML block only connect-src is needed — the script and fonts ship inside it.

conversations.emptyHint: Once the widget is live, every chat shows up here with its transcript.

playground.title: Playground
playground.empty: Ask the assistant something a visitor would.
playground.draftNote: The playground uses your current draft — including unsaved knowledge and unpublished settings. Nothing here is counted as a visitor conversation.
playground.debugNote: Debug retrieval shows which chunks were matched and how, so you can tell a missing source from a phrasing problem.

banner.title: Connect your OpenRouter key to activate assistants
banner.body: Assistants answer with your own OpenRouter account. Until a key is connected, publishing and indexing are paused.
banner.revokedBody: Assistants have stopped answering. Replace the key in settings. {{error}}
banner.publishDisabled: Connect an OpenRouter key in Settings → AI before publishing.

actions.title: Actions
actions.hint: Buttons the assistant can offer next to an answer — book a slot, call, email or open a page. At most six.
actions.empty: No actions yet. Add one to give visitors a next step.
actions.label: Button label
actions.showAskedHint: Also shown whenever a visitor asks for it — to call, to email, to book, or to see the page it opens.
actions.perLocaleHint: Leave a language empty to fall back to the label above. Translate fills only the empty ones.
actions.hostHint: Shown on the booking card and invited to the meeting.
actions.conversationalHint: The assistant can find a time, take their details and confirm, all in the conversation. The calendar card stays available.
actions.manageableHint: Visitors can move or cancel an appointment they already have, from the chat. They prove it is theirs with a code emailed to the address the booking is under. Off means the assistant answers questions about a booking but hands anyone who wants to change it to your contact details.

fallback.title: When it cannot answer
fallback.hint: Offered when the assistant has nothing relevant to say, so the visitor is never left without a way to reach you.
fallback.textPlaceholder: Call us on weekdays 9–17 or leave your details below.

gaps.title: Knowledge gaps (30 d)
gaps.hint: Questions visitors asked that the assistant could not answer, grouped by wording. Add the answer as text and it is indexed in a minute.
gaps.empty: No unanswered questions in the last 30 days.
gaps.unverified: Answer added, but the assistant still can't answer this —
gaps.resolveFailed: The answer was saved, but the gap could not be cleared

tests.title: Test questions
tests.empty: No test questions yet. Add the questions you expect visitors to ask.
tests.llmBody: Each of the {{count}} questions is answered by the model and graded for the expected keywords. This uses tokens on your OpenRouter key.
tests.note1: “Run all” checks retrieval only: does the right chunk come back? It is free.
tests.note2: “Run with LLM” also grades the wording of the answer. Run it after bigger knowledge changes.

wizard.title: New assistant
wizard.step1Hint: Pick a name and how it appears on your site. Both can be changed later.
wizard.step2Hint: Tell it about your business and point it at your website.
wizard.step3Hint: The assistant exists. Try it, publish it, or keep editing.
wizard.descriptionHint: Two or three sentences. The assistant reads this before every answer.
wizard.websiteHint: Up to 25 pages are crawled to start; raise the limit later from Knowledge.
wizard.createdBody: Sources index in the background. You can publish now and the widget picks up new knowledge as it lands.

publicAssistant.unavailableHint: The link may be wrong, or the assistant has been taken offline.
